theorem pentagonal_number_theorem_sum (R : Type*) [CommRing R] :
  ∃ p : PowerSeries R,
    ∀ n : ℕ,
      PowerSeries.coeff R n p =
        ∑ k in (Finset.Icc (-(↑n : ℤ) - 1) (↑n + 1)).filter (fun k => pentagonal k = n),
          if (2 : ℤ) ∣ k then (1 : R) else (-1 : R) := sorry
